purpose: Strengthen the application objective from fixed-menu evaluation to persistent RAKL mechanism/formalism discovery while preserving evidence integrity.

goal.normalized_scores_are: registered theory-tournament rubrics; they do not replace the domain-specific statistical gates below

descriptive_mechanism: candidate covers every Round-035 registered descriptive axis or explicitly derives an observational projection for it
mechanism ancestry links building blocks -> interactions -> state/regime -> spot observables
remaining structured residuals are below the registered materiality boundary or explained by a registered observation/noise model
major alternative mechanism families have discriminating evidence or remain explicitly bounded
predictive_spot: predictive improvement is attributable to observables available at decision time
predictive positive is linked back to the mechanism architecture or explicitly separated as phenomenological authority
formal_verification: dimensional or semantic-unit consistency where applicable
verification receipts bound to exact candidate id

when_candidate_fails: run GLUE and JUMP discovery as appropriate
select multiple non-equivalent constructive invention operators
freeze candidate predictions and falsifiers before native evaluation
when_all_current_candidates_fail: do not close the project as negative
open METHOD_BASIS_GAP_CANDIDATE if current invention operators cannot cross the residual
evolve the RAKL invention operator basis on development plus fresh assurance worlds
continue with the improved operator basis

integrity_invariants: no selective deletion of failed candidates
no in-sample fit relabeled as predictive success
no descriptive fit relabeled as mechanism without ancestry
